headers.//: Flutter does NOT content-hash these filenames - main.dart.js is main.dart.js on every build. If they are cached, a redeploy never reaches anyone who has already visited, and the only fix is telling every user to hard-refresh. Each path is listed explicitly: an @(a|b|c) extglob here silently matched nothing and these fell through to the catch-all below, which is how they ended up cached for a day on the first deploy.
Safe to cache forever: these filenames ARE content hashes - sha1(text)[:16] - so changed text means a different filename. See tools/generate_audio.py.
canvaskit ships inside the Flutter SDK and changes only with a Flutter upgrade, which also changes main.dart.js above. It is ~5MB gzipped, so caching it is what makes the second visit fast.
Images and fonts: stable names, rarely edited. One day, then revalidate.
